description: Multi Merge: merges sixteen inputs into polyphonic outputs, in as many separate groups as you patch outputs for

inputs.text: One of the inputs merged into the first patched output at or below its own row; the lamp beside it glows red when its channels did not fit within the 16 an output can carry

outputs.text: Carries the input of its own row and of every row above it, back to the next row with a patched output; patching or unpatching it regroups the module, and thick red lines show which inputs reach it

menu: Channels, in an input's own port menu — Auto reads the count from the cable, and 1 to 16 fixes it, a monophonic input then being repeated to that count and any missing channel counting as 0V
Channels, under the heading Configure all input ports: on the module's own menu — sets every input port's channel count at once
